content.text:
The Friday rule was already in `src/solution.py`. Meetings on a Friday can't start after 15:00, and a 15:00 start is allowed. I made these changes and didn't run any checks.

- **Lunch break removed:** the old code blocked start times from 12:00 to 13:00. The requirements don't mention a lunch break, so those starts are now allowed.
- **Back-to-back meetings allowed:** the old code treated a meeting ending exactly when an event starts as a conflict. Only real overlaps count now.
- **Friday check made safer:** it now trims whitespace around the day name and checks that `day` is a string.

I kept the 09:00–17:00 working hours and the 15-minute start-time steps. I also kept the existing conversion of ISO date strings to weekday names.
